_comment: Single source of truth for the dual-baseline, version-pinned design
Each entry pins one (env, source, file_type) tuple to a release_tag
+ mapping_version pair. Multiple entries per tuple are permitted -
they form a history. scripts/e2e_lib/baseline_resolver.py returns the
single entry whose mapping_version matches the version recorded in the
mapping JSON at run time. An MR that bumps a mapping_version MUST add
a corresponding entry here, or the L3 gate fails fast with
This file is APPEND-ONLY. scripts/promote_baseline.sh appends new
entries; never edit or delete existing entries by hand. Mapping owners
